questions.question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca0324a95defa670cc38b324977134c93c44e5bf00eba51c7b2d171d3b3f93be.png]
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is :

There are three inner figures which are changing positions, a circle, a triangle and a darkened asterisk/star sign.

→ The darkened asterisk sign moves one position left and then back to it's original position again in the next step and this repeats. 

→ The circle moves by one position in an anticlockwise direction in each step. 

→ The triangle moves by in an anticlockwise direction by one position in the first step, by two positions in the second, by three positions in the third and so on. 

So, the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8e25c1ee1cb1d9ca37d657db1307415e7a46069a1a5d0ac5ed8e9db1886e40c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dbdb741bf9a3e837f9f13b69aa950d00fc53e776df2c2293b64b8a895cf7c39.png] 

Thus, the figure in option(1) will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘TDG' is coded as '1680', 'BHI' is coded as '432'. What is the code for 'KCE' in that code language?
questions.solution:
The English alphabetical series is given as-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ce67ac5aac36118a3da2dce99ea82c3c3390cc36e7b5b3c64c92c7a9cf609b4.png] 

The logic is as follows:

Logic: (Product of place value of the alphabets) × 3 = Code. 

For ‘TDG' is coded as '1680':

→ 20 (T) × 4 (D) × 7 (G) = 560 × 3 = 1680. 

For 'BHI' is coded as '432:

→ 2 (B) × 8(H) × 9 ( I) = 144 × 3 = 432.

Similarly, for 'KCE', we get:

→ 11 (K) × 3 (C) × 5 (E) = 165 × 3 = 495.

Therefore, the code for 'KCE' is 495. 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth word in the same way as the fourth word is related to the third word and the second word is related to the first word.

ANT : ANTHILL :: DUCK : POND :: HORSE : ?
questions.solution:
Logic:

Animal : Habitat or place of stay. 

ANT : ANTHILL → An ant lives in an anthill.

DUCK : POND → A duck stays in the pond. 

Similarly, 

HORSE : STABLE → as a horse stays in a stable. 

Therefore, Horse is related to Stable by the same logic. 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some H are R.

II. No P are H.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some P are H.

II. Some R are not P.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
Given:

Statements:

I. Some H are R.

II. No P are H.

The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f79e27c357263a64cc715e8a215e0156d5f46c58914c3e0881a2c04595033b55.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some P are H. → **Doesn't follow**. (No P are H, so some P can never be H.)

II. Some R are not P. → **Follows**. (Some H are R and No P are H, this implies that some R are definitely not P.)

Therefore, only conclusion II follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
